confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of Tbilisi price levels, not live listings or booking pages. Restaurant anchors are moderately uncertain; accommodation is less certain, especially the 3-star July peak-season rate. Cocktail and wine_glass are not directly known and were set relative to the local beer estimate: cocktail at about 2x beer and wine_glass at about 1.25x beer. FX figure taken from search-result excerpts of the rba.gov.au exchange-rates overview page; that page was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Anchored to Caucasus and Eastern European mid-sized tourist cities such as Yerevan, Batumi, and Sofia/Bucharest-tier pricing, adjusted for Tbilisi's low local restaurant prices and July high-season hotel demand.
